name: PasswordPal
summary: A local-first password manager combining a Rust/Tauri backend with a React and TypeScript frontend for secure vault management.
whyItMatters: Uses a zero-knowledge design with AES-256-GCM encryption and Argon2 key derivation, zeroing keys from memory after use so vault data stays protected even during password changes.

name: Sensory Safari
summary: An interactive animal learning web app with a gallery, matching game, and quiz covering 33 animals.
whyItMatters: Built with autism-friendly accessibility in mind, featuring gentle colors, large touch targets, reduced-motion support, and full keyboard and screen reader navigation.

name: SafeApply
summary: The React and Vite frontend for SafeApply, a scholarship application system with dashboards for students, verifiers, and admins.
whyItMatters: Supports JWT-based authentication for multiple roles and client-side encryption via node-forge, giving each user type a tailored, secure interface.

name: PasswordPal Backend
summary: A zero-knowledge Node.js and Express API for PasswordPal that never sees or stores user passwords.
whyItMatters: Combines double-hashed authentication proofs, Argon2id, JWT sessions, and TOTP-based MFA with Supabase/PostgreSQL, so even a compromised database exposes no usable password data.

name: SafeApply Backend
summary: The Node.js and Express server for SafeApply, handling authentication, application processing, and secure data management.
whyItMatters: Implements role-based access control for students, verifiers, and admins alongside 2FA, rate limiting, and secure file uploads for scholarship documents.

name: Talent Radar
summary: An AI/ML candidate ranking pipeline that scores a pool of 100,000 candidates down to a ranked top 100 with fact-grounded reasoning.
whyItMatters: Combines hybrid FAISS and BM25 retrieval with a Ridge regression ranker and a rule-based Deterministic Reason Planner to generate non-repetitive, evidence-backed justifications within a 5-minute, CPU-only runtime budget.
